notes.title: Free DLC + Postmortem
notes.content:
I decided to release for free what I had planned for a little bonus DLC:
-7th and 8th unlockable playable characters (Nadia, Marcus)
-6 skins for the others (in shop after level 12).
-added Casual mode (and some little improvements)

-----
Some goals I had for SKD were: "trashy art but actually wholesome", "a side action game that doesnt feel like a lonely silent 1-character thing", and of course "challenging combat". It is clear now that this combo is still too tough to be attractive, even being free. Im still happy since that's exactly what I had in mind for SKD, it can definitely be a fun hidden gem for some!

I'll always love my first baby, but that's all I can do for it I think. It gave me lots of confidence that I can actually make something though, so now I really wanna try.. something a bit different! :)
